Class ItemManager

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.yam.games.asikart.ItemManager
public class ItemManager extends Object
ItemManager handles 3D game items in AsiKart 3D.

Manages stationary rotating Item Mystery Boxes (centered at height Y=0.65f), 3D Gold Coins, Green/Red Shell ballistics with collision logic, and Bananas.

Author:
anahata

  • Method Details

    • spawnItemBoxes

      public void spawnItemBoxes(List<com.jme3.math.Vector3f> trackWaypoints)
      Spawns stationary 3D rotating Item Mystery Boxes at track waypoints. Mystery boxes are placed at height Y=0.65f and rotated individually around their local center so they do NOT swing across the track.
      Parameters:
      trackWaypoints - Waypoints defining the track path.

    • spawnCoins

      public void spawnCoins(List<com.jme3.math.Vector3f> trackWaypoints)

    • update

      public void update(float tpf, com.jme3.scene.Node playerKartNode, List<com.jme3.scene.Node> aiKarts, String currentItem, ItemManager.ItemPickupListener listener)
      Main update loop for items, coins, shells, and bananas.
      Parameters:
      tpf - Time per frame.
      playerKartNode - Node of the player's kart.
      aiKarts - List of AI competitor kart nodes.
      currentItem - Current item held by player ("NONE" if empty).
      listener - Callback when an item box is picked up.
